blocks.text: Acid rain (tezabi barish) fiza (atmosphere) mein nitric acid aur sulphuric acid ka mixture hai jo industry ki aloodgi (pollution) se banta hai. Aam barish ke paani ka pH 5.6 ya is se kuch zyada hota hai, kyunke us mein carbonic acid (hawa ki CO₂ ghulne se) hota hai. Agar barish ka pH 5.6 se kam ho to woh acid rain ban jaati hai.

Acid rain fiza mein sulphur oxides (SOₓ) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ki wajah se hoti hai. Yeh gases, jo aksar industry ki aloodgi se aati hain, paani (aur oxygen) se react kar ke sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) aur nitric acid (HNO₃) banati hain.

Jab acid rain mitti par girti hai to aik chemical reaction hota hai jo mitti se zaroori nutrients, jaise calcium (Ca²⁺), magnesium (Mg²⁺) aur potassium (K⁺), ko dho kar nikaal deta hai (leaching). Yun yeh nutrients paudon ko nahi milte.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Mitti ke zarron (particles) ki satah par K⁺, Ca²⁺ jaise musbat ions chipke hote hain. Barish ke H⁺ ions in ki jagah le lete hain, aur K⁺ ya Ca²⁺ azad ho kar paani ke saath beh jaate hain. Kitab ka “H₂⁺—Soil” matlab hai mitti par chipke do H⁺ ions, yani (H⁺)₂—Soil; yeh H₂⁺ naam ka koi alag ion nahi. Isi tarah “H₃⁺—Soil” matlab teen H⁺ ions.

Saath hi acid rain aluminium (Al³⁺) jaisi zehreeli dhaton (toxic metals) ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) barha deti hai. Phir paude ki jarein inhein jazb kar leti hain aur khud kharab ho jaati hain. Is se paude ki nutrients lene ki salahiyat kam ho jaati hai, barhotri sust hoti hai aur fasal ki paidawar ghat jaati hai.

blocks.caption: Figure 32.3: Tezabi barish ke zaraat par asraat (kitab ki Figure 32.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aik manzar. Aasmaan: Sunlight sooraj se dotted lakeer O3 tak; kaale badal mein khana 'Cloud Chemistry: Pollutant Oxidation (SO2, NOx) -> Acid Formation (H2SO4, HNO3) -> Dissolution (Acidic Raindrops)'; barish par 'Acid Rain H+, NH4+, NO3-, SO4 2-' aur do bare qatre HNO3 aur H2SO4. Daen: dhuan chhorti factory 'SOx / NOx Emissions', ghar ke oopar 'Dry Deposition (SO2 / NOx)', sarak par truck aur car. Zameen: 'Natural Ammonia'; machhliyon wali jheel, 'Water Acidification (Harmful to Life)'. Baen, darakhton ke neeche mitti ka hissa: neeche jaate teer, 'Soil Acid Leaching'; H+ se teer Ca2+ aur K+ tak, jo beh jate hain, aur Al3+ tak, 'Aluminum Release (Toxic)'.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Factory aur gariyon se nikalne wali SO₂ aur NOₓ badal mein oxidize ho kar H₂SO₄ aur HNO₃ banti hain, jo barish ke qatron mein ghul kar acid rain banati hain. Kuch gases barish ke baghair seedhi zameen par bhi baith jaati hain (dry deposition). Mitti mein barish ke H⁺ ions Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ ki jagah le lete hain, jo paani ke saath beh jaate hain, aur zehreela Al³⁺ azad ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 32.3 mein mitti wale teer ulte hain: Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ se Al³⁺ ki taraf. Kitab ki apni leaching equations ke mutabiq H⁺ ions Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ ko hatate hain (jo beh jaate hain) aur Al³⁺ ko azad karte hain. Hamari drawing mein yahi sahi rukh hai.

Paudon par seedhi girne wali acid rain patton ko nuqsan pohancha sakti hai aur un ka paani khushk kar sakti hai, jis se paude bimariyon aur mahol ke asraat ke saamne kamzor ho jaate hain. Acid rain nitrogen fixation (hawa ki nitrogen ko paude ke kaam ki shakal mein badalna) aur nutrients ki jazbiyat kam kar ke soybean aur gandum (wheat) ki paidawar ghata sakti hai. Yeh mitti ke microorganisms ko bhi nuqsan deti hai, aur nutrients ke qudrati chakkar (nutrient cycles) aur organic maadde ke galne sarne (decomposition) ko bigaar deti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? (Did You Know?)
blocks.text: Tezabi jheelon mein machhliyan kyun marti hain? Acid rain mitti se Al³⁺ azad karti hai, jo machhli ke gills (galphare) band kar deta hai aur oxygen ki jazbiyat kam kar deta hai; is tarah machhli ka dam ghut jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Acid rain mitti ki zarkhezi kyun kam karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke H⁺ ions mitti ke zarron par K⁺, Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ki jagah le lete hain to yeh nutrients beh jaate hain, aur yeh zehreela Al³⁺ azad karti hai jo jaron ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: Acid rain: pH 5.6 se kam; SOₓ aur NOₓ se H₂SO₄ aur HNO₃ bante hain.
H⁺ ions mitti se K⁺, Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ nikaal dete hain (leaching) aur zehreela Al³⁺ azad karte hain.
Patte, soybean aur gandum ki paidawar, mitti ke microorganisms aur machhliyan mutasir hoti hain.
